text:
paige_legal: Customer wants 7-year retention of raw audit logs under BYOK. Need product/security guardrails + minimal acceptance criteria. Who can own?
ashley_product: I can. Quick confirm: do they require us to hold encrypted data in-system (BYOK-in-place) or to receive monthly encrypted exports to their bucket?
liam_security: They said customer-managed keys on their HSM. Two safe patterns: (A) store encrypted logs in our system with per-tenant key pointers and attestations, or (B) export monthly encrypted snapshots to customer storage with signed manifests.
sam_engineering: Notes: A needs KMS plugin + key rotation + audit controls, indexless archive option; B needs export pipeline, manifest + checksum, delivery receipts. Cost/effort lower for B.
jordan_sre: Ops needs: legal_hold toggle, export verification steps, signed manifest verification, restore RTO, and oncall playbook for missed exports.
paige_legal: Contract needs: custody wording (we never hold plaintext if BYOK-in-place), termination/export steps, evidence format (manifest + checksums), and liability allocation.
ashley_product: Draft acceptance checklist (short): retention_bucket="legal_extended" TTL=7y, key_model={"BYOK_in_place","monthly_export"}, delivery=monthly encrypted snapshot+signed manifest (SHA256), legal_hold toggle, export_sla=72h.
liam_security: Require attestation token on key registration, envelope encryption for exports with customer KEK, and logs proving no plaintext KEK in our systems.
paige_legal: Legal needs final acceptance text by Wed EOD to prepare contract language.
ashley_product: Action owners: ashley_product+liam_security finalize checklist by Wed; sam_engineering estimate effort + cost by next Tue; jordan_sre publish runbook draft by next Tue. I'll schedule customer sync.
opsbot: Doc created: https://tiny.redwood/byok-evidence-preservation-draft
paige_legal: Thanks — keep replies short here so legal can draft.
